== Summary ==

:{{pov|[[Elayne Trakand]]}}
Elayne is reminiscing about her childhood when [[Davram t'Ghaline Bashere|Bashere]] arrives. The two look down at the [[Alguenya]] river. They discuss the trap that they have walked into. They had tried to get ahead of a [[Trolloc]] army to the south of them but scouts have now spotted another Trolloc army coming from the north and heading to [[Cairhien (city)|Cairhien]]; a city now filled with refugees. Bashere suggests they confront the new northern army as they would be exhausted from a very long march. Elayne agrees and he makes plans. 

:{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}
Egwene enters ''Tel'aran'rhiod''. She meets with the [[Wise One|Wise Ones]] in the [[Stone of Tear|Heart of the Stone]]. She overhears them discussing [[Bair]] seeing through the eyes of her descendants on her third visit to [[Rhuidean]] as [[Aviendha]] did. Egwene approaches the group, apologizing for her intrusion, and she tells them she can't stay long as she has a meeting with [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]] later that day. They then ask her if she has noticed the odd deep black cracks in the rocks. They seem to appear more frequently when the [[Dreadlords]] fight. Egwene says that they are probably caused by [[balefire]] which Aes Sedai are forbidden to use. [[Amys]] tells Egwene that they will not be visiting the World of Dreams much anymore, as it has become dangerous to be there. They say their farewells to each other. 

Egwene awakes in her quarters at the [[The White Tower|White Tower]] and meets with Rand. He presents her with a ribbon, which initially makes her angry, but he tells her that he wants to make amends and to go into the [[Last Battle]] as friends. He says Egwene was always like a sibling to him and that the sibling he does have doesn't know him. Egwene expresses frustration at what she sees as a waste of time but Rand explains he didn't want to go to the Last Battle thinking their last words were in argument. Egwene embraces him and says she supports him though she still doesn't agree with his stance on the seals. [[Gawyn Trakand|Gawyn]] then asks Rand about his sibling and is shocked to learn that Rand is the half brother of [[Galadedrid Damodred|Galad]]. Egwene shows Rand the seals at his request. He reveals that the ones she has are fakes and asks if she has made copies to fool him but she denies it. They know the Dark One now holds the keys to his own prison. 

:{{pov|[[Matrim Cauthon]]}}
Not having the [[Seanchan]] look at him is frustrating Mat. There is a [[Moghedien|freckled so'jhin]] among servants who he would like to make smile but she refuses to even raise her head in his presence.  He is introduced to [[Nata]], his personal tailor who is making his new regalia. Mat just barely keeps from having his hat burned. They make him a ceremonial warriors outfit which seems too ridiculous and overdone to Mat. They lacquer his fingernails making him one the [[The Blood|Blood]]. He comes to the realization that, despite avoiding them for years, he's turned into a bloody nobleman.
